definitions.explanation: The initial starting point. Most commonly used in the expression 振り出しに戻る (to go back to square one), referring to returning to the beginning after progress is lost.

examples.japanese: {振|ふ}り{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧しまった。
examples.english: We ended up back at square one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決裂|けつれつ}→決裂：14895_ketsuretsu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、すべて⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{振|ふ}り{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: Negotiations broke down and everything went back to square one.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}えて→消える：02520_kieru⟧、⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{振|ふ}り{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧⟦やり{直|なお}す→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧。
examples.english: The data was lost, so there's no choice but to go back to the beginning and start over from scratch.

notes:
USAGE:
{振|ふ}り{出|だ}し originally refers to the starting square in a board game (like sugoroku). The expression {振|ふ}り{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧ (to go back to square one) is extremely common and is the primary way this word is used in everyday Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {振|ふ}り{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧ (to go back to square one)
- {振|ふ}り{出|だ}し⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from the beginning)
- {振|ふ}り{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧ (to put something back to the starting point)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The word comes from すごろく (Japanese backgammon/board game), where {振|ふ}り{出|だ}し is the starting square. Landing on certain squares sends you back to {振|ふ}り{出|だ}し.
